data.standardized_narrative: Opening (1 January 2018) gross claims outstanding per the Statement of Financial Position was GBP 37.982m. The report does not present an explicit gross prioryear (pre2017) movement figure in a clearly labelled 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note that could be extracted unambiguously. No single gross prioryear strengthening or release amount could be located with confidence in the text or notes provided.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding) 2017 comparative column (page 14). No unambiguous GROSS prioryear reserve movement figure (movement in prior years) was found in the available pages/notes; a claims development triangle appears in the notes but could not be reliably read/extracted from the scanned images, so prior_year_development is null. Segmental premium analysis is present (page 25) but individual class amounts could not be extracted with high confidence from the scans, so gross_premium_mix left empty. Where a figure could be read exactly (opening reserves, total gross premiums) those are provided. Report denominated in GBP (amounts shown in the report are in GBP '000).
